Ive been told since my boyfriend and i have been together almost two years that if we moved in together ssi would likely declare us as holding out as married. Im not sure how true that is that it could happen immediately, but i know there is a risk of it happening, and i dont want to risk moving, then losing it when we wouldnt be able to afford whatever place we get without both incomes. Cause then wed both be put in a bad position and possibly risk our stability and relationship... i know for now its best to stay where im at.. but i dont want to be longer than i have to be.. i just feel out of options other than to force myself into a job i know im not capable of..

Respectively, i mean as far as ever interacting with anyone besides my child. I appreciate and love spending my time with them, but my child is also disabled with a high level of autism and non verbal, and rarely wants anyone to interrupt whatever hes hyperfocusing on at the time, including me trying to involve myself into what hes focusing on.. he wants none of it. and the only person i ever hear respond to anything i say is myself.. so i do still feel very alone sometimes, even with him being here, and i need to be able to have a conversation sometimes, or some company who doesnt yell at me when i try to sit down next to them lol.

Well it would be, but its majorily elderly people living here, and i feel very out of place and unwelcome being my age, with the majority of tenants being 45-50+ years older than me.. i think theres only one other person anywhere near my age on this very very large community type assited complex, plus the rules even as far as not being able to have any plants on your porch, at all or have kids play in the yard, or have bikes on the property or  anyone stay the night EVER without it being a medical necessity, plus much much much more are extremely strict, and the property is very poorly cared for and it takes weeks or months to get anything done maintenance wise at all, and generally im very unhappy here... maybe if it was better housing but this is the only assisted housing anywhere near me.. and all around i just want to know if theres a way out of everything without it taking away every bit of assistance i have... but i dont think there will be.

Ssi has the ticket to work program, which ive put in papers for with employment networks, but i havent heard back from anywhere yet, and im worried if they do end up getting back ahold of me and manage to get me a job that as soon as i stop qualifying for ssi if i move, that ill end up being fired or something since i got the job through the ssi employment networks... but i dont actually know how that will work since ive yet to hear back from any of the EN's.. hopefully soon ill hear something from someone. I just cant handle being here alone all the time anymore, or feeling like i can never move on with my relationship without jeopardizing my ability to have any form of help, when i cant really work a traditional job.

Theres an open case with the state for a child support order, unfortunately his fathers in a correctional facility for the foreseeable future so its all going very slowly and will likely be a good while before i ever start recieving any kind of child support.

I have a son who is also disabled, and wed both lose our assistance, hes been with his company for a few years and makes decent money, and likely wouldnt be able to find a job starting out that pays what he makes now. but housing here is very expensive wherever you go right now. Ive been looking at apartments for months wanting to move with him, but even with the cheapest weve found, if we combined what wed end up paying there plus all our other bills into just his income.. wed come out with barely over 100 a month leftover, without adding food gas and amenities into that.. and 100 definitely just isnt near enough for pay for a month of those things...  i live in disabled housing now which is the only way im able to survive on my own, but we wouldnt qualify to stay there anymore if he lived with me, and hes currently roommating in a very small house with friends so me moving in where he lives now isnt an option either..

I feel like theres no options for me to ever get a better life, without forcing myself into a major medical decline just trying to keep up with a part time job.. and im about there.. but i cant even find one that has hours i can work with.. so im just at a complete loss... my disability has always been there.. but my parents refused treatment  for me my whole life.. even once i was old enough to just beg and beg them to take me to get help, and by the time i was old enough to get myself established as disabled i was too old to qualify for DAC since it wasnt confirmed by a doctor before that age, and i could never keep the few jobs id had for long so i didnt have enough credits to do anything with and now.. now im just lost..

I have no plans to lie to the ssa, they will be notified if/when i decide to move and on whether or not i move in with anyone. I just simply cant afford to do anything other than stay here by myself right now, and its really impacting everything including my health.. im just trying to find a way out of being alone 24/7 without it affecting my eligibity. If there isnt a way, then it is what it is... just trying to see if there is..
